utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Good morning, everybody. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Good morning to everyone in the courtroom. This is case number IT-98-29/1-A, the Prosecutor versus Dragomir Milosevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. May I have now the appearances of the parties. For the Prosecutor, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. BOUDREAULT
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Francois Boudreault appearing together with Barbara Goy and our case manager Alma Imamovic-Ivanov.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Now for the Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. I am Branislav Tapuskovic appearing for Dragomir Milosevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. May I now address Mr. Milosevic. Can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you for asking. I am hearing you. Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Now, this Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. The previous Status Conference in the present case was held on 22nd August 2008. Due to the fact that the next Status Conference would have fallen during the judicial recess and considering the scheduling of trials, the Status Conference was scheduled for today by order of 11 November. Now, first, I would like to inquire into the status of the conditions and health situation of Mr. Milosevic. By now, Mr. Milosevic, you know that according to Rules 80 to 84 of the Detention Rules, where a detainee is not satisfied with the conditions of detention, he or she is entitled to "make a complaint to the Commanding Officer or his representative at any time," and, in case of an unsatisfactory response, to "make a written complaint ... to the Registrar, who shall inform the President." In this respect, we should recall that during the last Status Conference you had raised some concerns about the conditions of your detention and health. If you wish, if you have anything to say in this respect, the discussion could take place in private session, if you so wish, if you have anything to say in this respect now. But perhaps we should go into private session because I have something to say myself.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honour, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. Now, before -- you may be seated, Mr. Milosevic. Now before turn to other issues, I would like to recapitulate briefly the recent procedural history. The briefing for the Prosecution appeals, which is limited to question of sentencing, is now complete. The Defence notice of appeal was filed on 11 January 2008. Pursuant to my decision of 20 February 2008, the Defence was permitted to file its appeal brief within 15 days of his receipt from the Registrar of the official B/C/S translation of the trial judgement. The appeal brief was filed in time on 14 August 2008. On 23rd September, the Prosecution filed the response brief, followed on 9 October by the reply of Mr. Milosevic. So now the briefing is complete. A motion was filed on 10 November by counsel for Milosevic to seek additional evidence admitted under Rule 115. The Appeals Chamber will deal with this motion in due course, when the briefing on the motion will be complete. In light of this, it's premature to set any date for the hearing in this case, but I hope the appeals hearing may take place during the first half of next year. This, of course, is a matter that the Appeals Chamber will have to decide upon in due course. Now, that's it about the procedural history. At this point, I would like to ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise at this point. First, is there any issue that the Prosecution would like to raise now?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Now let me turn to the counsel for Mr. Milosevic. Do you have any issue you would like to raise now, Mr. Tapuskovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I'm not feeling too well today, but since there is not much to be discussed today, the Defence does not have any issue to raise. I have received the information that the appeals hearing might take place in the first half of next year. Thank you for that. I have no particular issues to raise at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. Tapuskovic. That being the case, if there is no other issue to be raised, I believe this concludes our business today. I thank the parties for their attendance and call these proceedings to a close. The hearing is concluded.
